limits: Explicit limited baseline, not a verified adapter for every agent product.
No independent delegates/cross-judge, per-worker model choice, private session-history API or scheduling claimed.
Use the agent's actual native file/shell operations; the user must select its skill directory.
If task acceptance requires unavailable independent execution or integrations, report blocked rather than calling a fallback equivalent.

snippets.files: Use this agent's actual native file-reading, searching and editing facilities; execute real helper/Git/test commands through its shell capability. Read before replacing existing files and verify written results. If a required operation is unavailable, stop with the evidence gap instead of inventing a tool API.
snippets.delegation: This generic baseline provides no independent subagents or cross-judge. Perform permitted candidate designs, coverage slices and reviewer lenses sequentially in this session, then synthesize inline. Keep outputs separate and compare all required slices. Label them same-agent perspectives, not independent reviews or different models. If independence is a user requirement, report blocked and request a verified adapter rather than silently substituting. Do not guess spawning APIs or claim durable workers.
snippets.task_tracking: Use the host's native checklist if available; otherwise maintain a compact task-local phase checklist. Record verified completion, omitted work and blockers without inventing a task-tool schema.
snippets.history: Use only the active conversation and project-local Git/docs/issues that are actually accessible. No private session-history tool is assumed. Record missing historical sources explicitly; do not scan unrelated users/projects or fabricate past rationale.
snippets.skill_loading: Read the named skill and supporting files through this host's real file/skill facilities. References are relative to that skill directory. If the host does not expose the named skill, locate the installed file directly or report the missing dependency; no particular skill-loader API is assumed.
snippets.skill_maintenance: For explicitly approved edits, use native file tools on the confirmed skill/project destination, preserve local changes and verify content. Do not modify global prompts, another installation or credentials. For mp repository maintenance edit core source and regenerate/review the selected output instead of hand-editing generated instructions.
snippets.configuration: This baseline does not configure the host runtime. Keep existing model/provider/reasoning settings unchanged. State task-local preferences only; inspect actual documented facilities and obtain separate approval before any runtime settings write. No per-role routing or permanent prompt rule is implied.
snippets.integrations: Use only capabilities and authenticated integrations actually exposed by the host and within user scope. Discover their real schemas/documentation before execution. Missing connectors are evidence gaps. Loading a skill never installs routes, recurring jobs, dependencies or credentials; read back every authorized external write.
snippets.persistent_work: No durable background execution is supplied by this baseline. Finish bounded permitted work in the session and leave resumable artifacts/handoff for unfinished tasks. Do not invent schedulers or promise continued execution after the session ends.
snippets.web: Use only the host's verified browser/desktop/vision facilities. Never infer unseen pixels or request secrets in chat. Follow the host's approved secure credential flow; if none is available, have the user complete authentication locally. No particular browser, webhook or MCP tool is assumed.
snippets.setup: Use the trusted source checkout to select this explicitly limited baseline, acknowledge its capability limits and confirm the destination skill directory. Generate and verify the output before installation; refuse collisions and do not alter runtime configuration.
